messages:
maria: Heads-up — perf alert from CI: runtime selector p95 latency jumped ~2x on the seqlen-sweep job after PR #3421 landed. Alert started at 1955554300 but I only noticed now.
jason: Yup saw the same. Canary perf gate failed during the nightly run. Bisect points at commit a7f3b2a (kernel selector scoring tweak).
sophie: Is that commit reverted anywhere? I see a revert on main (#3439) but release-1.12 still has a7f3b2a.
raju: I'll create a hotfix branch for release. Plan: cherry-pick the original pre-PR commit that restores previous scoring. Branch name: release/1.12/kselector-hotfix.
jason: Suggested commands:
```
# on local
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.12/kselector-hotfix origin/release-1.12
git cherry-pick -x <commit-before-a7f3b2a>
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/release/1.12/kselector-hotfix
```
Then open backport PR against release-1.12 and request QA.
maria: Please include the perf regression test that caught this in the PR: tests/perf/selector_regression.py — we need an automated p95 guard.
sophie: Running staging verification now after raju's cherry-pick. Command I'm running:
./infra/perf/run_perf.sh --suite=seqlen-sweep --concurrency=8 --runs=20 --tag=staging-verify
raju: Backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3452 — includes cherry-pick and a small fix to the selector heuristics. Marked as hotfix/backport.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #3452 — unit tests + perf-suite.
ci-bot: Perf suite completed: baseline p95=48ms, with hotfix p95=24ms, p99 improved similarly. See CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/3452/artifacts/perf_histogram.html
sophie: Verified locally on staging: p95 returned to normal (~23ms). No tail regressions observed. I also ran the perf regression test — passing.
jason: OK — can we do a controlled canary on prod? Suggest rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 10min holds and perf probe.
maria: Agreed. I'll coordinate the canary rollout after approvals. Tagging @oncall for the production window.
raju: I'll prepare the release notes and cherry-pick to the release branch and ensure CHANGELOG entry: "fix(kernelselector): revert scoring tweak that regressed p95"
jason: Reminder to add a short postmortem once rollout is done: include CI gap that allowed the PR through, timeline, and follow-ups (add perf-gate to PR template + required perf run for selector changes).
maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread pinned to the release-1.12 hotfix. Will update when prod canary starts.
devops-bot: Deployment to staging for release/1.12/kselector-hotfix succeeded at 1955554395.
maria: Marking this as tracked — will close thread after prod verification. :white_check_mark:
